newsitem.title: UK: LLoyd Thompson, JIB announce merger plans.
newsitem.headline: LLoyd Thompson, JIB announce merger plans.

text.p: Insurance companies Lloyd Thompson Group Plc and JIB Group Plc said on Monday they had reached agreement on the terms of a proposed merger of their respective businesses.
Under the terms of the offer, JIB Shareholders will receive four New Lloyd Thompson shares for every five JIB shares held.
Following the merger, Lloyd Thompson will be renamed Jardine Lloyd Thompson Group plc.

The companies said they believed that the merger would bring significant strategic advantage to Jardine Lloyd Thompson allowing the development of new products and revenue growth, enhancing JIB's international operations and creating a leading international reinsurance business.
The deal would also produce cost savings, in particular in the two London market operations, information technology and head office expenditure.
The benefits expected to arise from the deal will be significantly beneficial for Jardine Lloyd Thompson earnings per share in 1998, the companies said.

Jardine Matheson Holdings limitewd JARD.L which has a 60 percent stake in JIB said it supported the proposed merger. On completion of the deal it will have a 34 percent interest in the enlarged group which it said, it intended to hold for the long term.
